environment.description: Same application containerized and deployed in a Kubernetes pod (namespace: rendering) on EKS. The namespace has a NetworkPolicy resource applied with spec.podSelector matching all pods, spec.policyTypes including Egress, and spec.egress rules that enumerate allowed CIDR blocks for the storage backend (10.0.0.0/8) and DNS (kube-dns on port 53). The policy does NOT include 169.254.169.254/32 in any egress allowlist. Note: the Calico CNI plugin (v3.25) is installed as the network policy enforcement engine. Additionally, the EKS node group has IMDSv2 enforced (HttpTokens: required) at the launch template level, but the pod itself does not have the hop limit set to 1 — the NetworkPolicy is the primary control preventing metadata access from the pod network namespace.

config.imds_config: IMDSv2 required at node level, HttpPutResponseHopLimit=2
